title: AFGRI Farming Learnership 2026/27 – Vastfontein Training Farm
source_name: AFGRI Farmer Development recruitment portal (reference AO-2494)
description: A 12-month fixed-term farming learnership at the Vastfontein Training Farm in Pretoria North, offered by AFGRI Farmer Development. Open to unemployed South Africans with Grade 12 or an equivalent qualification; women and people with disabilities are given preference. Apply through AFGRI's online recruitment portal before 28 October 2026 and confirm all details there.
eligibility: Women and people with disabilities receive preference; historically disadvantaged individuals are encouraged to apply
documents_needed: Proof of Grade 12 or equivalent qualification
